description: Capability: build a small tool from scratch with an exact behavioral contract, then verify it. Measures sustained multi-step construction (Terminal-Bench-style build-a-tool), not just editing.
goal: Build a Dart CLI at tools/csv2json.dart: it takes one CSV file path as its argument and prints a JSON array of row objects — header names as keys, values kept as strings except integers which are parsed as ints, output compact (no extra whitespace). Verify on data/sample.csv before finishing.
